title: Define accountable alert handling and IHR-based reporting
requirements:
- Replace 'immediate/real-time' with condition-specific deadlines and failure handling
- Link cross-border exchange to IHR and regional frameworks, defining authority, data scope and security
- Require governed alert methods with human review
- Define recipients, acknowledgement, escalation and closure, linked to response authority
- Harmonise normative terms and actor responsibility in the requirements
